description: Pinned tier-2 test assets (DESIGN.md section 16.1, D-IP-17, D-IP-19). Every entry is fixed by URL, SHA-256, and byte count; tools/fetch_test_assets.py verifies each one into tests/.cache/<id>/. Models and images are never committed. Licenses are permissive by decision D-IP-17: YOLOv8 and YOLO11 (AGPL-3.0) and MVTec AD (CC BY-NC) are excluded.

assets.name: mobilenetv2-12.onnx
assets.source: ONNX Model Zoo (onnx/models), validated/vision/classification/mobilenet, pinned at commit 4f43949841cb55a0b98dc8fcd045431ccafd9f96
assets.notes: ImageNet-1k classifier, opset 12, input input [batch_size,3,224,224] with a dynamic batch axis, output output [batch_size,1000] logits. Backs the classification bundle of the live suite.

assets.name: resnet50-v1-12.onnx
assets.source: ONNX Model Zoo (onnx/models), validated/vision/classification/resnet, pinned at commit 4f43949841cb55a0b98dc8fcd045431ccafd9f96
assets.notes: ImageNet-1k classifier, opset 12, input data [N,3,224,224] with a dynamic batch axis, output resnetv17_dense0_fwd [N,1000] logits.

assets.name: yolox_nano.onnx
assets.notes: COCO detector, anchor-free grid head exported without in-graph decoding: input images [1,3,416,416], output output [1,3549,85] of (dx,dy,log w,log h,objectness,80 class scores) with objectness and class scores already sigmoid-activated. Drives the yoloxGrid decode path.

assets.name: yolox_s.onnx
assets.notes: COCO detector, same head as YOLOX-Nano at 640x640: input images [1,3,640,640], output output [1,8400,85].

assets.name: ssd_mobilenet_v1_12.onnx
assets.source: ONNX Model Zoo (onnx/models), validated/vision/object_detection_segmentation/ssd-mobilenetv1, pinned at commit 4f43949841cb55a0b98dc8fcd045431ccafd9f96
assets.notes: COCO detector with an already-decoded head and in-graph resizing and suppression: input inputs uint8 NHWC with dynamic height and width, outputs detection_boxes [1,N,4] normalized yxyx, detection_scores [1,N], detection_classes [1,N] as one-based COCO category ids, num_detections [1]. Drives the decodedBoxes decode path.

assets.name: fcn-resnet50-12.onnx
assets.source: ONNX Model Zoo (onnx/models), validated/vision/object_detection_segmentation/fcn, pinned at commit 4f43949841cb55a0b98dc8fcd045431ccafd9f96
assets.notes: Pascal VOC 21-class semantic segmentation, input input [batch,3,height,width], outputs out and aux [batch,21,height,width]. Stands in for DeepLabV3-MobileNetV3, which the ONNX Model Zoo does not publish and which has no other prebuilt permissively licensed ONNX; only out is declared in the bundle and read by the segmentation family.

assets.name: synset.txt
assets.source: ONNX Model Zoo (onnx/models), validated/vision/classification/synset.txt, pinned at commit 4f43949841cb55a0b98dc8fcd045431ccafd9f96
assets.notes: The 1000 ImageNet-1k class names in the index order both classification models produce, one WordNet id and name list per line. The classification bundles carry the first name of each line as labels.json.

assets.name: imagenette2-160.tgz
assets.notes: Ten easily told apart ImageNet classes at 160 pixels on the shorter side, laid out as imagenette2-160/val/<wnid>/<image>.JPEG. The directory name is the ImageNet class, so a top-1 label is checkable without any annotation file.

assets.license: COCO Terms of Use; annotations CC BY 4.0
assets.source: COCO val2017, the images.cocodataset.org bucket read over the path-style S3 endpoint
assets.notes: The first 200 val2017 images by image id. Images are test-only and never committed or redistributed. The path-style host is pinned because the TLS certificate images.cocodataset.org presents is issued for *.s3.amazonaws.com and does not match that name; the bytes are identical and every image carries its own SHA-256. Annotations are not fetched: the suite compares against its own committed goldens, not against COCO ground truth.

assets.name: VisA_20220922.tar
assets.source: Amazon Visual Anomaly (VisA), amazon-science/spot-diff, the amazon-visual-anomaly S3 bucket
assets.notes: The capsules good and bad splits live at capsules/Data/Images/Normal and capsules/Data/Images/Anomaly. The bucket publishes only the full 12-object archive: listing it returns VisA.tar and VisA_20220922.tar and nothing smaller, so there is no capsules-only artifact to pin. Marked optional so the default fetch stays under two gigabytes; pass --include-optional or --only dataset-visa to get it.
